question: To file the nomination for the post of Vice President, the candidate must be proposed by at least _________ electors.
solution:
The correct answer is __**20**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• To file the nomination for the post of Vice President of India, the candidate must be proposed by at least **20 electors**.

• Additionally, the nomination must be seconded by at least another **20 electors**.

• The nomination paper must be submitted to the Returning Officer appointed for the election.

• These electors proposing and seconding the nomination must be members of the electoral college for the Vice Presidential election, which consists of members of both houses of Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Electoral College for Vice President:**

• The Vice President of India is elected by an electoral college consisting of members of both houses of Parliament, namely the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha.

• Members of state legislative assemblies are not part of the electoral college for the Vice Presidential election.

• The election is conducted using a single transferable vote system and voting is done by secret ballot.

• **Eligibility Criteria for Vice President:**

• A candidate must be a citizen of India.

• They must have completed 35 years of age.

• They must be eligible to be a member of the Rajya Sabha.

• They should not hold any office of profit under the Government of India, any state government, or any local or other authority subject to the control of any of these governments.

• **Term and Powers of Vice President:**

• The Vice President of India serves a term of 5 years.

• The Vice President acts as the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha and presides over its sessions.

• In the event of the President's death, resignation, removal, or otherwise, the Vice President acts as the President until a new President is elected.
